text:
[issue by Minimaxi28]
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Mod Loader

Forge

### Trash Cans version

1.1.1

### Game environment

Client

### Steps to reproduce

Identical to #57 
Unfortunatly, it's still crashing

- Download JEI and Trash Cans (+Core and Config Lib)
- place down Fluid Trash Can
- try to drag and drop water from JEI to the Trash Can's filter
- lava also crashes and other fluids from other mods too

### Crash report (~/logs/latest.log)

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32701359/latest.log)

[crash-2026-09-27_15.45.37-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32701363/crash-2026-09-27_15.45.37-client.txt)

[comment by Minimaxi28 (none)]
JEI version : 15.62.0.216

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
Pretty much the same issue as #57, but for a different method. It seems `FriendlyByteBuf#writeNbt` signiture was changed from accepting a `CompoundTag` to any `Tag`.
It should be fixed in Trash Cans version 1.1.1a for Forge 1.20 - 1.20.4 and Fabric 1.20 - 1.20.4.
Thanks again for reporting the issue!
